Bikol-Naga: Pira an bayad sa pagsubli nin bag saiyang tindahan?
English Translation: How much is the fee to borrow a bag in their store?

Bikol-Naga: Mag-iwas ka sa peligro habang nagbabyahe.
Sain ka maduman ngunyan na hapon?
English Translation: Where are you going this afternoon?

Bikol-Naga: Magsakay kita sa dyip paduman sa plaza.
English Translation: Let's ride the jeepney heading to the plaza.

Bikol-Naga: Magbaba ka na duman sa tapat nin ospital.
English Translation: Disembark now in front of the hospital.

Bikol-Naga: Magtrabaho kita nin tultol nganing magka-igwa nin maogmang buhay.
English Translation: Let us work properly so that we will have a happy life.

Bikol-Naga: Dakula an harong kan sakong mga magurang sa Naga.
English Translation: My parents' house in Naga is big.

Bikol-Naga: Madiklom an agihan dahil sa kawaran nin ilaw.
English Translation: The road is dark due to the lack of lights.

Bikol-Naga: Pagal an sakong hawak pagkatapos nin halabang paglakbay.
English Translation: My body is tired after a long journey.

Bikol-Naga: Mag-aram ka nin bag'ong kanta para sa satong pagtipon.
English Translation: Learn a new song for our gathering.

Bikol-Naga: Nagtitiwala an mga tawo sa matanos na namumuno sa banwaan.
English Translation: The people trust the honest leader in town.

Bikol-Naga: Nag-iingat an drayber sa madalandag na kalsada pag nag-uuran.
English Translation: The driver takes care on the slippery road when it is raining.

Bikol-Naga: Kamo daw an mapuno nin tubig sa dulaan sa kusina?
English Translation: Will you be the ones to fill water in the container in the kitchen?

Bikol-Naga: Dini sa satong lugar, masagana an ani nin gulay.
English Translation: Here in our place, the harvest of vegetables is abundant.

Bikol-Naga: Saindo an bag'ong kagamitan sa laog nin kwarto.
English Translation: The new equipment inside the room belongs to you all.

Bikol-Naga: Ito an mataas na bulod na nahiling ta kasuudma.
English Translation: Over there is the high mountain we saw yesterday.

Bikol-Naga: Marhay na aga sa saimo, lolo asin lola.
English Translation: Good morning to you, grandfather and grandmother.

Bikol-Naga: Madiikit an kakanon na natada sa lamesa ngunyan.
English Translation: There is a little food left on the table now.

Bikol-Naga: Hinanap kan aki an saiyang nawarang ayam.
English Translation: The child searched for their lost dog.
I have something to tell you.

Bikol-Naga: Nagdadanon kita sa mga tawo na nangangailangan nin tabang.
English Translation: We help people who need assistance.

Bikol-Naga: Magkarigos ka bago magkaon nin pamahaw sa aga.
English Translation: Take a bath before eating breakfast in the morning.

Bikol-Naga: Ano an saimong gustong ibakal sa bagong saod?
English Translation: What do you want to buy at the new market?

Bikol-Naga: Magbalik ka giraray para sa masunod na kapiestahan.
English Translation: Come back again for the next festival.

Bikol-Naga: Ingat ka pirmi sa saimong pagbyahe paduman sa banwaan.
English Translation: Take care always on your journey to town.

Bikol-Naga: Mabalos sa gabos na nagtiwala asin nag-aagapay sato.
English Translation: Thanks to everyone who trusted and supported us.

Bikol-Naga: Maogma kaming nahiling ka sa bagong eskwelahan.
English Translation: We are happy to see you at the new school.

Bikol-Naga: Dios mabalos sa saimong pagkamoot asin katanusan.
English Translation: God bless you for your love and righteousness.

Bikol-Naga: Magsipilyo ka nin ngipon bago maturog sa banggi.
English Translation: Brush your teeth before sleeping at night.

Bikol-Naga: Mabuot asin matinabangon an satong mga katrabaho.
English Translation: Our coworkers are kind and helpful.

Bikol-Naga: Nagluluto si nanay nin pangudto sa kusina.
English Translation: Mother is cooking lunch in the kitchen.

Bikol-Naga: Maogma an mga aki habang nagmamag-adal.
English Translation: The children are happy while studying.
We are happy to help you.

Bikol-Naga: Maogma an satong pag-iriba sa eskwelahan.
English Translation: Our companionship at school is joyful.
We are working for the family.

Bikol-Naga: Marhay na banggi sa saindong gabos.
English Translation: Good evening to all of you.
Take a bath before going out.

Bikol-Naga: Magwalis ka sa laog nin kwarto.
Sain ka maduman sa masunod na aldaw?
English Translation: Where are you going next day?

Bikol-Naga: Matyaga si ama sa pagtatrabaho sa bukid.
English Translation: Father is persevering in working on the farm.
Be careful on the slippery road

Bikol-Naga: Maugma an mga aki sa eskwelahan.
English Translation: The children at school are happy.

Bikol-Naga: Dios marhay na banggi saimo, kaibigan.

English Translation: We are going to the market

Bikol-Naga: Kita an maduman sa saod nganing magbakal.
English Translation: We will go to the market to buy.

Bikol-Naga: Duman sa harayo na bulod dakul an kahoy.
English Translation: There on the distant hill are many trees.

Bikol-Naga: Ta'no ta kailangan mag-ingat pag nagbabyahe?
English Translation: Why is it necessary to be careful when traveling?

Bikol-Naga: Nag-iingat an drayber sa madalandag na kalsada.
English Translation: The driver takes care on the slippery road.
Why are you in a hurry?
Story of old times in town

Bikol-Naga: Sain nakatago an mga paninda sa saod?
English Translation: Where are the goods hidden at market?

Bikol-Naga: Nag-aadal kami nin husto sa eskwelahan ta.
English Translation: We study hard in our school.

Bikol-Naga: Nagtitiwala an mga tawo sa matanos na katood.
English Translation: The people trust an honest friend.

Bikol-Naga: Nag-oomaw an mga tawo sa laog nin simbahan lambang amay na aga.
English Translation: The people praise inside the church every early morning.

Bikol-Naga: Nag-aani nin masagana na gulay an mga paratanom sa bukid.
English Translation: The farmers harvest abundant vegetables on the farm.

Bikol-Naga: Malisipon an mga aki sa laog nin klase kan paratukdo.
English Translation: The children in the teacher's class are attentive.
